sentences.text: Admit.
Heard finally by consent.

2. By this application, the applicant is seeking quashing of FIR in connection with Crime No.613/2022 registered for offences under Sections 406 and 420 read with 34 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 7 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.
3. The criminal law was set in motion on the basis of a report lodged by the informant, who is Education Officer and total 132 schools of Nagpur Municipal Corporation come under his control.
In view of Scheme of the Government to provide "Mid-Day Meal" in different aided schools so also the schools of the Nagpur Municipal Corporation, E-Tender was called.

On 12.10.2022, the informant received a letter from the police that they have caught one vehicle "Tata ACS bearing .....3/-
Judgment 12 apl1642.22 No.MH-36/AA/1606 carrying rice bags.
On enquiry with the driver of the said vehicle, he informed that the rice owners are accused namely Chandrashekhar Bhisikar and Amol Bhisikar.
On inspection of the rice bags, it was found that rice in the said bags is the same as provided to the aided schools under the Scheme of "Mid-Day Meal Scheme".
Accordingly, one rice bag of 50 kilograms having label "Bharat Sarkar" and 40 rice bags of 50 kilograms approximately are seized and the driver of the said vehicle was taken into custody.
The investigation was carried out and on the basis of statement of the co- accused, it revealed to the investigating agency that the applicant has purchased the rice.
On the basis of the statement of the co-accused, the applicant came to be arrested and implicated in the alleged crime.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that besides the statement of the co-accused, there is .....4/-
Judgment 12 apl1642.22 absolutely no material to show that the applicant has purchased the rice from the other co-accused.
Thus, merely on the basis of the statement of the co-accused, his involvement is allegedly revealed.
Thus, from recital of the FIR it shows that there is no connection between other co-accused and the applicant.

However, during the investigation, the investigation agency has recorded statements which are not admissible in evidence and besides the said statements, there is no material collected during the investigation and, therefore, no prima facie case is made out against the applicant.

5. Per contra, learned APP for the State strongly opposed the said contentions and submitted that during the investigation, it revealed that the applicant is also involved in purchasing the said rice reserved for the "Mid- Day Meal Scheme" for providing "Mid-Day Meal" to children who are studying in municipal schools.

Thus, .....5/-
Judgment 12 apl1642.22 due to the act of the applicant, the children are deprived from getting the "Mid-Day Meal".
In view of that, the application deserves to be rejected.

6. On hearing both the sides and on perusing the entire chargesheet, admittedly, except the statement of the co-accused, there is absolutely no material to connect the applicant to show his Satish Sukhdev Nirmalkar vs State Of Mah. 9. Though chargesheet is not filed by the investigating agency, investigation papers are perused by .....6/-
